command_shape: <native_ncn Python> -B <packet>/probe.py --execute-authorized --source-root <PHASE> --repository <same main repo> --device cuda:0 --output <fresh output> --public-b-dir <exact existing publicB projection>

comparison.all_coordinates: Every tensor in diagnostics/adapted returned phi/raw costs/Q/probe private gradients/main private gradients for response1 vs response2.
comparison.limitations: A successful two-sample comparison is a bounded observation; it does not establish determinism of all PyG/external scatter kernels or qualify an episode/fitting.
comparison.reporting: Per-path every-coordinate finite/tolerance counts, scale max/RMS, abs max/RMS, max-error index/value/limit and first8 violating indices/values/limits, plus exact metadata/structure differences; first failing path and maximum-error path in RESULT.

completion_status: DETERMINISTIC_RESPONSE_PROBE_COMPLETE_NO_QUALIFICATION; tolerance violations remain reported. Strict backend rejection and process restoration failures use explicit non-PASS statuses.
failure_accounting: Closed-per-event physical/staged attempted-operation stream; attempted meters, independent callback counts, original input/native/aliases/modes/buffers/RNG/gates restoration checked in finally after response setup; atomic partial RESULT retained; external termination requires root receipt.

fixed_calls.input_phi: The SAME ORIGINAL private phi rows, never adapted response rows.
fixed_calls.input_theta: The SAME single initial theta bank, from seed17 family; no theta+ and no episode call.

fixed_native_context.family_constructor: Unchanged SHA-bound BASE.build_family; no warm fitting/checkpoint.
fixed_native_context.graph_roles: Exact existing publicB manifest/provenance must equal supplied completed diagnostic receipt, including public graph/processed edges/roles.

process_configuration.backend_flags_recorded: Deterministic enabled/warn/debug mode, available cudnn enabled/deterministic/benchmark/TF32 and CUDA matmul TF32/fp16/bf16 reduction flags.
process_configuration.restoration: Exact saved deterministic enabled/warn state and other available backend flags; derived debug mode is verified. Environment prior presence/value restored in nested finally, including failure. Reversible CPU thread count restored; interop setting is never changed.
process_configuration.thread_setup: One CPU thread matches predecessor construction/preprocessing; unchanged process interop count recorded.

purpose: Discriminate same-state response variability under strict framework mode without retrying an episode/outer derivative or promoting any prior failure.

resources.whole_process: Elapsed/RSS/CUDA allocated/reserved peaks include imports/setup/snapshots/comparison logging; peaks never reset.

runtime_metadata: Torch/PyG module paths and versions, Torch CUDA and cuDNN versions, installed scatter/sparse/pyg-lib distribution versions, GPU name/capability, process flags and thread metadata.
unsupported_backend: Retain exact primary RuntimeError text and complete traceback plus last attempted physical/staged operation. Recognize explicit deterministic/workspace rejection without inventing an operator name; no warn-only/CPU/precision/context/kernel fallback. Preserve primary error if restoration also fails. Other runtime errors retain their own failure status.
